mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies out at Badger Prairie County Park with temperatures sitting at 78 degrees, though please be aware of the elevated air quality index of 54 today.

In city news, the design period for the I Voted sticker contest has ended. Verona students in grades K through 12 submitted their artwork, and now the community will have the chance to vote on the finalists from July 28 through August 7 to determine the designs used for the November election.

There is a lot of fun on the horizon. We have live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Louie both happening today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Square in Madison or catch the music series at Paddy Mac's.
Looking at the weekly police report, on Sunday, July 13, officers responded to a situation where a 36-year-old man was arrested for his first O-W-I offense after his vehicle became stuck on a rock.

You are in for a treat today because the flavor of the day is Chocolate Volcano. Culver's of Verona is open until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to head over and enjoy a scoop before they close for the night.
